draftSummary.coreValueProp: Decentralized auditing and governance protocols for secure and transparent smart contract management

intendedFlow.description: A user requests an audit of a smart contract through the AUDITS protocol
The AUDITS protocol executes the audit and identifies potential security vulnerabilities
The AUDITS protocol generates an audit report, which is reviewed and addressed by the protocol's governance structure
The governance structure makes decisions on the protocol's development and maintenance based on the audit report
The AUDITS protocol is deployed on various blockchain networks, ensuring secure and transparent auditing of smart contracts

mainContracts.description: The main contract for the AUDITS protocol, responsible for executing audits and generating reports
The contract responsible for governing the AUDITS protocol, making decisions on development and maintenance
The contract responsible for deploying the AUDITS protocol on various blockchain networks
